Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent sprite sheet for an age-of-sail naval battle game.
Create ONE consistent monster across EXACTLY 8 COLUMNS and 6 ROWS, 48 equal rectangular cells in a perfectly regular edge-to-edge grid. Canvas landscape 4:3, ideally 1792x1344. No gutters except equal transparent padding within every cell. NO text, numbers, grid lines, borders, checkerboard, sea backdrop or scenery.
Style: detailed but readable small game sprites, hand-painted low-poly/pixel-art hybrid with crisp silhouette, muted rich colors, warm upper-left light, orthographic camera looking DOWN 55 degrees onto water plane. Consistent physical scale comparable to a huge Chinese treasure ship. Individual subject max 80 percent cell width, generous transparent safety margin, water-plane center near 50% x 62% y of each cell. Only a small local foam/ripple beneath each sprite, no square water tiles.
COLUMN DIRECTIONS identical in EVERY row, head/bow points: 1 EAST/right, 2 NORTHEAST/upper right away, 3 NORTH/up away (back visible), 4 NORTHWEST/upper left away, 5 WEST/left, 6 SOUTHWEST/lower left toward viewer, 7 SOUTH/down toward viewer (face visible), 8 SOUTHEAST/lower right toward viewer.
ROW STATES: Row 1 surfaced idle calm; Row 2 swimming motion different active pose and small wake; Row 3 powerful attack pose (no victims); Row 4 diving beneath water, only upper body/appendages visible, tight foam and lowered silhouette; Row 5 fully hidden underwater, ONLY small oval ripples and bubbles with a very faint submerged shadow, NO visible solid body; Row 6 re-emerging upward with a compact splash and head visible.
Maintain same anatomy, design, color, size and camera across all 48 frames. Every cell independent and isolated. TRUE alpha transparent background.
Subject: KRAKEN: an immense abyssal squid, elongated dark indigo-purple pointed mantle, two long grasping tentacles and eight shorter muscular arms, pale copper suction cups, amber predatory eyes. Clearly elongated squid silhouette unlike a round octopus. Attack whips two long arms outward; swimming streams arms behind; diving mantle descends and tentacle tips linger.

COLUMN head directions: 1 EAST right; 2 NORTHEAST upper-right away from viewer; 3 NORTH up away, back of head visible, eyes facing away; 4 NORTHWEST upper-left away; 5 WEST left; 6 SOUTHWEST lower-left toward viewer; 7 SOUTH down toward viewer with face visible; 8 SOUTHEAST lower-right toward viewer. Maintain these eight real yaw angles for EVERY row, back view really different from front view.
ROW 1 surfaced calm idle.
ROW 2 swimming active different body pose and compact wake.
ROW 3 powerful characteristic attack pose without a victim; limit attack effect within cell.

ROW 5 FULLY SUBMERGED, no solid monster above water, ONLY small oval ripples and bubbles and barely perceptible submerged shadow. Absolutely no body, fins, trees, horns or solid appendage above water in this row.

Only ONE monster in each cell. No people, no ships, no moons, no scenic props, no icons.
